publications.title: Colon Cancer
publications.abstract:
Colon cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer
related deaths worldwide, and early detection is vital for 
improving patient outcomes. This paper presents a deep 
learning-based framework for automated colon cancer 
classification using microscopic histopathological images. The 
primary objective is to systematically compare and evaluate 
multiple architectures to identify the most reliable diagnostic 
model. A dataset of 10,000 images, including 2,000 for 
independent testing, was preprocessed using Multiscale CLAHE 
(MCLAHE) to enhance structural details. Features were 
extracted with three pretrained CNNs EfficientNetB3, VGG19, 
and ResNet152 and classified using Neural Networks, LSTM, 
and BiLSTM, resulting in nine configurations.

publications.title: Colon Cancer Classification
publications.abstract:
Colon cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer
related deaths worldwide, and early detection is vital for 
improving patient outcomes. This paper presents a deep 
learning-based framework for automated colon cancer 
classification using microscopic histopathological images. The 
primary objective is to systematically compare and evaluate 
multiple architectures to identify the most reliable diagnostic 
model. A dataset of 10,000 images, including 2,000 for 
independent testing, was preprocessed using Multiscale CLAHE 
(MCLAHE) to enhance structural details. Features were 
extracted with three pretrained CNNs EfficientNetB3, VGG19, 
and ResNet152 and classified using Neural Networks, LSTM, 
and BiLSTM, resulting in nine configurations. Performance was 
measured with accuracy, F1-score, MCC, Youden’s Index, G
Mean, and Cohen’s Kappa.

publications.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Smart Healthcare
publications.abstract: This paper presents a novel deep learning framework for predictive healthcare diagnostic systems using multi-modal patient sensor data, achieving superior accuracy in early cardiovascular disease classification.

publications.title: Secure IoT Framework for Smart Campus Infrastructure
publications.abstract: We propose a lightweight cryptographic key management protocol for edge-assisted IoT sensor deployments across university smart campuses.

publications.title: Machine Learning Based Precision Crop Yield Prediction
publications.abstract: Integration of satellite imagery and localized soil moisture sensor data with ensemble gradient boosting trees for regional crop yield forecasting.

publications.title: Cloud-Based Research Data Management and FAIR Compliance
publications.abstract: Architectural evaluation of distributed cloud repositories enforcing Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) data principles for academic institutions.

publications.title: AI Assisted Medical Image Classification Using Vision Transformers
publications.abstract: Vision Transformers applied to high-resolution MRI scans enable zero-shot segmentation of tissue anomalies with reduced computational overhead.
